1 خَنِزَ , aor.
خَنَزَ ; (S, A, * Msb, K;) and خَنَزَ, aor.
خَنُزَ ; (Msb;) inf. n. of the former, خَنَزٌ, (S, Msb, K,) and of the former also, (K,) or of the latter, (Msb,) خُنُوزٌ; (Msb, K;) It (flesh-meat, S, A, Msb, K, and a date, and a walnut, TA) became stinking: (S, A, K:) or altered [in odour] : (Msb:) or maggotty and stinking: (TA:) like خَزِنَ. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
